_comment__file_purpose: Controls runtime inference: feature extraction, template matching, correspondence filtering, and PnP pose estimation.

infer_opts._comment__object_dataset: Dataset name used to locate templates and representations.
infer_opts._comment__repre_version: Representation version to use during inference.
infer_opts._comment__crop_rel_pad: Relative padding applied when cropping detected object regions to avoid cutting off geometry.
infer_opts._comment__crop_size: Crop resolution (width, height) used for inference. Smaller is faster; larger retains more context.
infer_opts._comment__use_detections: If true, assumes external object detections (e.g., bounding boxes) are provided.
infer_opts._comment__extractor_name: Feature extractor configuration. Must match the extractor used during representation generation.
infer_opts._comment__grid_cell_size: Spatial grid resolution for feature extraction. Typically equals ViT patch stride.
infer_opts._comment__match_template_type: Template descriptor type used for matching. Must match representation (e.g., tfidf).
infer_opts._comment__match_top_n_templates: Number of top-matching templates passed to pose estimation. Higher improves recall but increases cost.
infer_opts._comment__match_feat_matching_type: Feature correspondence strategy. Cyclic buddies enforces mutual nearest-neighbor consistency.
infer_opts._comment__match_top_k_buddies: Number of feature correspondences retained for PnP. More improves robustness but adds outliers.
infer_opts._comment__pnp_type: PnP backend used for pose estimation. OpenCV uses solvePnPRansac.
infer_opts._comment__pnp_ransac_iter: Number of RANSAC iterations for PnP. Higher increases robustness at the cost of runtime.
infer_opts._comment__pnp_inlier_thresh: Reprojection error threshold (pixels) used to classify inliers during PnP.
infer_opts._comment__final_pose_type: Strategy for selecting the final pose estimate from candidates.
infer_opts._comment__num_preds_factor: Multiplier on the number of pose hypotheses generated. Useful for multi-hypothesis evaluation.
infer_opts._comment__vis_results: If true, visualizes intermediate matches and final pose estimates for debugging.
